summary: Tutorial framework and lesson 1 (cards and card types). Play -> Tutorial now starts an offline lesson against the practice bot with illegal clicks locked out. Lessons are scripts over the real engine (L5R.Core/Tutorial: fixture table, TutorialRunner, TutorialLessonOne); the runner switches off every option the step does not ask for, refuses stray commands, and plays the opponent's side. Client: MatchSession.StartTutorial, a coach column (TutorialCoachPanel), a pointer pulse on CardTile, and a lab (--tutorial-review). No rules change. Crane vs Lion, 52 steps over two turns ending with a destroyed province and the Ring of Fire reaction.
validation: tools/check.sh passes (client included); tutorial suite 6/6 (full lesson played through the runner, locking, Border Keep and attack-province refusals, quoted card numbers checked against the catalogue, starting table); tools/check-tutorial.sh plays all 52 steps through the real table controls to 9 Honor with no ERROR lines; check-main-menu, check-table-camera, check-board-ui, check-direct-play-ui pass. Not done: a human playtest.
remaining: Final lesson that unlocks the table for a full game, later lessons, pointing at the phase bar, polish of coach copy after a human read. Event is Willing Spirits (effect lands next turn) and 'boxable' was read as inexpensive: both to confirm.
